newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond tests new limits.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond tests new limits.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract tested both sides of a new trading range during SYCOM, touching a new 3-1/2 year high of 93.270 at one stage.
*U.S. Treasuries ended little changed in slow session, although underpinned by buying on any dips.

The September Australian 10-year bond futures contract tested both sides of a new range during after hours trading after breaching 93.210 resistance on Tuesday, touching a new 3-1/2 year high of 93.270 at one stage.
The contract ended SYCOM at 93.235, up a tad from Tuesday's 92.230 close, and after earlier dipping to 93.205.
Analysts saw the contract likely trawling a 93.180 to 93.280 range prior to Thursday's key labour force data and with U.S. Treasuries' recent strong rally showing some signs of flagging.
The U.S. market ended Tuesday little changed during a slow session, although it was underpinned by buying on any dips.
